risks: Thin margin room: Rs 200 cost is 28.6% of Rs 699; any cost above ~Rs 203/pair, or a price cut below Rs 699, likely drops it BELOW_TARGET on the website-only channel
Meesho copper glass pair price unknown; Meesho sells a copper bottle + glass combo at Rs 699, so Rs 699 for two glasses may look expensive to marketplace shoppers
'Pure copper' claim needs a material test report from the supplier (policy require_evidence_for_claims); Rs 100/piece may mean thin gauge or copper-plated steel
Supplier in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh: website-only per docs/05 (bill-to-ship-to, CA to confirm); MOQ and single-piece drop-ship need a written quote
Dents and tarnish in transit drive returns; needs a rigid gift box and care card (lemon/salt cleaning, no dishwasher)
Avoid health/Ayurvedic claims in copy (would edge toward regulated claims); describe as drinkware only
Retail comparables come from search snippets and Flipkart related-product tiles, not opened listing pages; re-check live prices
GST rate for copper tableware (HSN 7418) to be confirmed by the CA; 12% used as an estimate

review.notes: No hard-rule breach and no mass-marketplace pair found at or below Rs 450, but the 'pure copper' claim has no material test report (documents empty; policy require_evidence_for_claims) and Rs 100/piece (IndiaMART listing, not a quote) is the price point most at risk of thin-gauge or plated stock; margin passes only at Rs 699 with Rs 200/pair cost (36.8%) and fails at Rs 599 (27.1%) or Rs 280/pair cost (23.4%), while verified comparables sit at Rs 500-599 and the Rs 755-906 Flipkart figures are stale cached tiles.
